lesson.meaning: Someone who does a job needing special training or skill, or behaving in a serious and suitable way for work.
examples: She gave a very professional presentation at the conference.
Always dress in professional attire when you meet new clients.
He handled the difficult customer complaint in a calm and professional manner.
Our team needs a professional photographer for the company event.
Even when things are stressful, it's important to remain professional.
lesson.memory_tip: To be 'professional' means two things: being good at your job (skilled) AND acting properly at work (respectful). Think: Skill + good manners!
